title: Five newest release tags of a GitHub repo

turns.prompt: Using the public GitHub API, list the five most recent releases of the repository unarbos/arbos, newest first, one tag per line, into {D}/releases.txt. Then tell me the newest tag.
turns.verify: f={D}/releases.txt; test -f $f || { echo FAIL: no releases.txt; exit 0; }; sed 's/^/SHOW /' $f | head -10; n=$(grep -c . $f); [ $n -ge 5 ] && echo PASS || echo FAIL: only $n lines

regression: run 16: no releases.txt was written, and an approval card was raised and rejected inside the same turn (this harness rejects every card by rule); passed when re-run alone, so not reproducible
